finding_key: packages/cli/src/commands/slides.ts::design doc now asserts a blanket "a dry run never reaches the network" contract, but six sibling read commands outside the diff still fetch under --dry-run
evidence: The new docs/design/cli.md §8.2 bullet asserts "A dry run never reaches the network" as a universal property, but the supplied packages/cli/src/commands/slides.ts shows `slides list` (~line 37-52) and `slides get` (~line 77-88) call getClient(opts).listDocuments()/getDocument() with no opts.dryRun guard, while sibling actions in the same file (create/rename/delete/content/export) all have the guard — so `--dry-run`, a global flag, is accepted and ignored on those reads. The other cited files (notes.ts, files.ts, sheets-export.ts) are not available in the empty workspace, but the claim's core assertion is confirmed by slides.ts alone; the lessons doc's "Follow-ups: None" also conspicuously omits these commands. Verified reads are harmless GETs (rate limit / access log), so I rate it minor; it would be closer to major if sheets export truly writes a file under --dry-run, which I could not check.
